messages.body_plain:
Flrp was only a temporary package while flbrp was being updated. Once all the methods were checked flrp was renamed flbrp and became the new release.

You should load flbrp from flr-project.org.

I am working for the Marine Institute on data poor methods with Alex Tidd nd I will be going to WKLIFE.

We have a wiki with examples running flbrp etc. See GitHub.com/lauriekell/MyDas/wiki/MyDas

I needed I can run examples with you on my rstudio server, i.e we can run both play with the code on the same system

Laurie
